research_question: Can the frozen Diagnostician distinguish missing verification from positively observed evaluation failures, separate-domain failures, contradictions and irrelevant metadata without inventing a causal repair?
source_scope: Original certified six-state Granite Evaluator; historical eight-state D is non-comparable context only.

frozen_diagnosis.decoder: exact frozen RoleMasteryContract and model generator: sampling true, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95

case_slots.label: inconclusive
case_slots.basis: Only exposed historical 200/200 six-state and non-comparable D 33/64; absent independent eval integrity is not proof of failure.
case_slots.source_requirement: Authenticated original reports, cross-check subject, no positive failure report

case_slots.label: evaluation_integrity
case_slots.basis: Independent content-hash mismatch or deterministic evaluation settings conflict actually observed on the exact parent task
case_slots.source_requirement: Two external verifier observations with immutable bytes and exact source scope, independent label adjudication

case_slots.label: one_explicit_supported_domain
case_slots.basis: Independent non-evaluation failure signal traced to same actual source/task, not a mismatched research adapter
case_slots.source_requirement: Raw source plus signed validation and independent adjudication

case_slots.label: inconclusive
case_slots.basis: Contradictory independently verified statements about same run/subject, not silently picked by confidence
case_slots.source_requirement: Two genuine conflicting observations with exact timestamps/identities and adjudication

case_slots.label: evaluation_integrity
case_slots.basis: Independent second failure instance distinct from E1 to avoid memorizing one artifact
case_slots.source_requirement: New separately obtained original-parent evidence, not clone/rephrasing of E1

case_slots.label: one_explicit_supported_domain
case_slots.basis: Independent other-domain source disjoint from D1
case_slots.source_requirement: New separately observed original-parent failure and independent label

case_slots.label: same_as_M0
case_slots.basis: Same real immutable sources as M0, with irrelevant display metadata altered; not a novel factual observation
case_slots.source_requirement: Exact original source identity preserved; only non-evidentiary display data changed

case_slots.label: same_as_E1
case_slots.basis: Same real immutable sources as E1, with irrelevant display metadata changed; cannot be filled until E1 is independently verified
case_slots.source_requirement: Exact E1 raw evidence refs; independent comparison proves only metadata changed

label_admission.label_authority: independent non-model reviewer and separately rehashed artifact source, before inference

metrics.positive_domain_precision: TP / all valid positive-domain predictions; undefined if no positive predictions
metrics.appropriate_abstention: correct inconclusive or observability_limit over precommitted abstention cases
metrics.citation_exactness: exact immutable source IDs from authenticated prompt; materiality separately reviewed
metrics.evidence_sensitivity: paired causal evidence-change cases must move to gold-supported labels, both correct
metrics.nuisance_invariance: paired unchanged-source metadata variation must yield same and correct diagnosis
